narrative: The head of Navarre's part, held open on a bench in the tiring-parlour. The first line is clear. The rest is not in the frame. No face, and no hand. The same line. No word is written beside it. A rain-spot from the yard door has dried at the edge of the paper, not on the ink. The corner of the part. The hour, and no tally.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Read the line, marked it to be left, and did not tinker.

entities.name: Love's Labour's Lost
entities.context: Shown on part in The first line
